title: Protection from heat and flame.
officialText: Tanks shall be located at least 7 feet (2134 mm), measured in the most direct manner, from any source of exposed flame unless protected as provided in Section 1305.11.1.2, Exception 3, and at least 2 feet (610 mm) from any surface where the temperature exceeds 165°F (74°C).
